request.idea: Every clock in the world suddenly stops except one.

bible.title: The Clock with the Broken Circle
bible.userIdea: Every clock in the world suddenly stops except one.
bible.premise: Every clock in the world stops except one. Leo, Ravi, and Mina must discover why its ticking reaches nobody else.
bible.hook: Why does one clock keep ticking while every other clock stands still?
bible.goal: Find what prevents the remaining clock from sharing its ticks, and restore the connection.
bible.centralProblem: A missing link has broken the enchanted chain that carries the keeper clock's ticks to every other clock.
bible.stakes: Until the children repair the connection, the world's clocks cannot move beyond the same unfinished minute.
bible.motif: A circle with one small gap.

locations.name: the clockwork room
locations.visualIdentity: A round room with blue walls, a tall brass clock, and a glowing dial showing clocks across the world.

entities.name: the keeper clock
entities.identity: A tall brass clock whose ticking supplies the world's clocks through an enchanted circular chain.
entities.state: Ticking steadily with its inspection door closed.

entities.name: the world dial

entities.state: Showing clocks throughout the world moving again.

entities.name: the tick chain
entities.identity: A brass chain inside the keeper clock, with a gap where one link belongs.
entities.state: A complete, correctly sized circle carrying ticks outward.

entities.name: the loose link
entities.identity: A small brass link with two openable ends, matching the gap in the tick chain.
entities.state: Installed securely between the chain ends.

expresses.shows: She compares the moving brass hands with the motionless hands across the glowing dial.

sentences.text: Leo and Ravi watched the world dial: every clock in the world had stopped.
Beside it, the keeper clock ticked on, its front inspection door standing open as though nothing at all had changed.
Mina pointed from the dial to the clock.
"They're all stopped except this one. Why does this clock get to keep going?"
